title: rubus hirtus var. validipes
intro: Rubus hirtus var. validipes, commonly known as Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus hirtus var. validipes include wound healing, digestive issues, and anti-cancer activities due to its bioactive constituents, such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including ellagic acid and salicylic acid, contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
